checks.description: activation: IncomeFirstLogic.ReserveHarvesterRecovery is the new branch. Once four refineries stand and the fleet is short of the docking places they provide, one harvester's price (1,100) is reserved for the Vehicle queue so the Infantry queue cannot spend the trickle first. The reservation policy is recorded on every assessment whether or not it suppresses anything, so an absent id means the gate was never reached rather than that the rule was wrong.

outcome: the direct measure of the change. Nine harvesters were built last match and the last one was ordered at 747s, 690 seconds before the war factory died; the fleet then went 9, 6, 4, 1, 0 between 1,140s and 1,320s with cash sampled at 1, 0 and 157. If the reservation works, the side buys more harvesters than the nine it managed.

outcome: 585 seconds of the match had no live harvester and lifetime earnings froze at 55,930 credits from 1,260s, which is what produced 30.8 credits a second against a reference of 50 and a prior median of 38.5. Across the last ten runs the four highest incomes are exactly the four best fitness scores, so this is the metric the change is betting on.

invariant: a reservation that starves the barracks is the failure mode this rule is one step away from. Only the last 1,100 credits are defended and the reservation stands down for sixty seconds whenever it has not grown the fleet, so total spend must not fall. 34.9 credits a second last match against a prior median of 43.8; below last match's own figure the reservation is holding cash nothing is spending.

invariant: the reservation is released while enemies are at the base precisely so it cannot trade the garrison for an earner during a raid. Losses were 71,120 credits last match, a 49% regression against a prior median of 47,680, and an economy rule that made that worse would be buying income with the base. This is the ceiling that says it has not.

outcome: mean army value was 1,802 against a reference of 6,000, the worst-scoring fitness component at 0.30, and every winning run in the last ten held between 8,966 and 22,088. Income is what pays for an army, so a working economy fix should show here as well as in the earnings; if income rises and this does not, the credits went somewhere other than the army.

outcome: fitness was 0.6565, dead on the prior median of 0.658, with economicRate 0.62, valueExchange 0.49 and armyValueIntegral 0.30 the three components off their caps. Buildings, exploration and survival are already capped and have slack, so any real gain has to come from the economy half.
